analysis: Four locked pathway-level tests; no gene-level tests or classifier fitting
primary_endpoint: Study-defined clinical benefit: confirmed CR/PR or stable disease maintained at least6months, five versus23. The six-month criterion applies to stable disease; it is not required for every objective responder.
secondary_BH_note: Objective response only, 2versus26, is an exploratory sensitivity with a separate four-pathway BH family. Endpoint amendment was explicitly user-requested before any trial pathway scores were inspected.
interpretation: Single-arm exploratory archival-tissue association; no treatment interaction or validated clinical cutoff.
public_projection: Original frozen numerical computation unchanged. Private absolute paths replaced with relative source identifiers; endpoint prose clarified after independent clinical metadata review.
reproducibility_boundary: Aggregate outputs are published, while local subject-labelled matrices/scores/clinical joins are not. Recomputing full statistics requires the externally sourced native quantifications/metadata and fixed admission; no raw-read rerun occurs from aggregate files alone.
